items.description:
Pick n Pay in Strand Square is a full supermarket stocking groceries and household essentials, with fresh produce, fresh breads and baked goods, and a meat counter alongside everyday toiletries. The store also operates a PnP Liquor outlet and a recycling point, and offers PnP Courier Services and a range of pre-cooked meals for shoppers wanting a quicker option. The branch keeps extended trading hours on weekdays, giving shoppers more time to get their shopping done outside the usual nine-to-five.

The store trades from Strand Square on Fagan Street in Strand, and suits households doing a full weekly shop as well as shoppers picking up fresh bread, meat or a pre-cooked meal, posting a parcel, or recycling on the same visit.

Pick n Pay in Tyger Valley Shopping Centre is a full-service supermarket trading from Shop 559 in the centre's food precinct, stocking groceries, fresh produce and household goods for everyday shopping. The centre's own store directory lists the branch under its food category, with its own trading hours and contact details separate from the rest of the mall.

The store opens from nine in the morning to seven at night on weekdays and Saturdays, and keeps shorter hours of nine to five on Sundays and public holidays, giving shoppers a reliable window for a full shop most days of the week.

The supermarket trades from Tyger Valley Shopping Centre on Bill Bezuidenhout Avenue in Bellville, and suits shoppers doing a weekly grocery run or a quick top-up while visiting one of the northern suburbs' busiest shopping centres.

Prima Hire Builders Plant is a construction equipment hire business operating from its own yard on Bosman Street in Eerste River. Listed under the construction equipment category, the business supplies building and construction plant and machinery to contractors and other customers working on site.

The yard keeps set weekday and Saturday trading hours, giving customers a clear window to collect or return hired equipment around a working week, rather than operating purely by appointment.

The business is based at 8 Bosman Street in Eerste River, and suits building contractors, renovators and other customers in the surrounding area who need construction plant and machinery hired out for a job rather than bought outright.

Safety Protective Clothing in Epping Industria manufactures and distributes personal protective equipment and workwear meeting SABS and CE standards. Its range covers PPE coveralls, conti suits, safety boots, lab coats, hard hats, barrier netting, ear plugs and safety spectacles.

The business also supplies gloves in nitrile and leather, rainwear, freezer wear, reflective vests, chef wear, dustcoats, mop caps, sleeve protectors, aprons and full-body harnesses. This range spans everyday workwear through to specialised safety equipment for industrial and food-service settings.

The company is based at Unit 9, Magnum Park on Bofors Circle in Epping Industria, and suits businesses needing bulk protective clothing and safety gear for staff in factories, kitchens or on site.

Sakura Beauty Bar in Welgemoed is a beauty salon built around what it calls the art of mindful beauty, with therapists taking time to understand each client's needs before any treatment begins. Its custom treatments include waxing with careful aftercare, nail art shaped around a client's style, and brow and lash work designed to suit individual features.

The salon also offers facials chosen for each client's skin type, from consultation through to the finishing touch, along with massage therapy focused on comfort and tension relief. The salon describes its approach as one where clients are listened to, treatments are made personal, and small details are never rushed.

The salon is in the Welgemoed Centre on Kommissaris Street, and suits clients looking for an unhurried, detail-focused beauty appointment in the northern suburbs.

Sheet Street at Vangate Mall is a branch of the national home furnishings and textiles retailer, trading from Shop 58 inside the mall. The store's own branch page lists it separately from other Sheet Street stores, with its own set of contact details and trading hours specific to the Vangate Mall location.

Shoppers can expect the chain's usual range of bedding, curtaining, towels and other home textiles, sold from a dedicated storefront rather than a shared department, with staff on hand during the store's own posted hours rather than those of the wider mall.

The store is at Shop 58 in Vangate Mall, on the corner of Vanguard Drive and Klipfontein Road in Athlone, and suits shoppers looking to pick up linen, curtains or other home textiles while already shopping at the mall.

items.description:
Sidewalk Cafe in Vredehoek is a long-standing neighbourhood restaurant run by the Madame Zingara group, known for its cosy, hodge-podge country kitchen décor. A Cape Town Etc review found the restaurant unchanged after years away, with the same carefully considered menu and the same relaxed, homely atmosphere.

The menu includes fresh juices made to order, and the signature chicken, prawn and pea risotto, alongside a changing fish of the day and other mains such as fillet steak. Other dishes on the table in the review included spinach and ricotta parcels and a vegetarian penne, with cheesecake among the desserts on offer.

The restaurant is on Derry Street in Vredehoek, and suits a relaxed dinner built around comfort food and familiar flavours done well.

Sorbet Salon at Riverlands Mall offers an extensive treatment menu covering manicures, pedicures and specialised pedicures, gel nails and nail repair, facials, waxing, threading, brows and lashes, makeup and sugaring. The branch's own page describes the salon as aiming for guests to leave with a smile, with trained staff delivering the full range of Sorbet's nail, skin and beauty treatments under one roof.

Booking is available in person, by phone or through the Sorbet app, which also covers loyalty points and gift cards across the group's salons, nail bars and hair bars.

The salon trades from Shop G48 in Riverlands Mall in Observatory, and suits anyone looking to combine a manicure or pedicure with a facial, wax or brow treatment in a single appointment.

items.description:
Steers at Liberty Promenade is a quick-service restaurant trading from Shop 196 inside the centre, serving the chain's flame-grilled burgers, chicken and ribs alongside its hand-cut chips. The centre's own shop listing confirms the branch's contact details and trading hours as a tenant of the mall rather than a stand-alone outlet.

Being inside the centre puts the restaurant within reach of other Liberty Promenade shoppers, making it a convenient stop for a quick meal between errands rather than a dedicated sit-down booking.

The restaurant is at Shop 196 in Liberty Promenade, on the corner of AZ Berman Drive and Morgenster Road in Mitchells Plain, and suits shoppers and locals wanting a fast meal while out at the centre.

Steers Melkbosstrand is a flame-grilled quick-service restaurant at Birkenhead Shopping Centre, serving the chain's burgers, chicken and ribs together with hand-cut chips and thick shakes. The branch's own official listing gives it daily trading hours of 10am to 9pm, open every day of the week rather than keeping shorter weekend hours.

Dine-in, takeaway and delivery are all available from the branch, giving customers in the coastal town more than one way to get their order, whether that is a sit-down meal or something collected on the way home.

The restaurant is at Shop 19B in Birkenhead Shopping Centre, on the corner of Otto du Plessis and Birkenhead Road in Melkbosstrand, and suits a quick family meal or a takeaway order after a day at the beach.

Stor-Age Springfield Road is a self-storage facility offering individually alarmed units in more than 40 different sizes, suited to anything from a few boxes to a full household move. The facility also sells packaging supplies, offers dedicated business storage, and provides van hire and parcel collection for customers who need more than just a unit to rent. Security includes controlled access, surveillance cameras and regular patrols, and leases run flexibly, with units available to rent for as little as one month rather than a long-term contract.

The facility is on Springfield Street in Ottery, keeping set weekday and Saturday-morning hours and closing on Sundays, and suits households moving or renovating as well as businesses needing extra storage space in the southern suburbs.

Surfshack on the Camps Bay beachfront is a contemporary, diner-inspired eatery with a view-drenched terrace offering front-row seats to the ocean, and a rustic-chic interior for a more laid-back setting. A review by Inside Guide describes the vibe as chilled yet buzzy, drawing both locals and tourists to the beachfront.

Sharing plates on the menu include crispy corn on the cob, tempura crab claw, blistered jalapeño peppers and seared ahi tuna, while mains run from barbecue lamb chops and grilled chicken kebabs to dry-aged sirloin on the bone and a bucket of shellfish. The menu also includes a pizza section and a range of burgers, among them a lobster roll, a hot pastrami dog, a hot honey fried-chicken burger and a bacon-beer-and-cheese burger, finishing with sweet options such as frozen mousse, banana cream pie and milk panna cotta.

The restaurant is at 201 The Promenade on Victoria Road, and suits a relaxed meal with sunset views over the Atlantic.

Tekkie Town at The Junxion Mall in Philippi is a footwear retailer that promises great customer service alongside a wide range of quality branded footwear, clothing and accessories at affordable prices. The store caters for the whole family, stocking international brands including Nike, Adidas and Puma.

The branch positions itself as a one-stop option for sneakers and casual footwear for parents and children shopping together, rather than a specialist store for one type of shoe. It trades from Shop 08 in the mall, on the corner of Govan Mbeki and New Eisleben Roads.

The store suits families in Philippi looking for branded sneakers, shoes and accessories without needing to travel to a bigger mall.

The Barber's Range in Bothasig Square offers haircuts, fades and scissor cuts for men and children, along with head and face shaves, waxing and hot-towel grooming treatments. The branch's own page notes that customers can simply walk in rather than needing to book ahead, making it a convenient stop for a quick trim or a full grooming session.

The shop keeps long weekday hours into the evening, with shorter hours on Fridays and weekend trading on Saturday and Sunday, giving working customers and families flexibility around when they come in.

The barbershop is at Shop 8 in Bothasig Square on Vryburger Avenue, Bothasig, and suits men, children and pensioners looking for a straightforward haircut or grooming treatment without needing an appointment.

The Indian Oven in Hout Bay's Red Sails Building is a North Indian restaurant at the foot of Chapman's Peak, with chefs using traditional recipes and fresh, locally sourced ingredients. The restaurant's extensive menu runs from savoury curries to spicy biryanis, alongside tandoori and paneer dishes made with authentic spices.

Diners consistently praise the biryani and curries, describing the food as consistently delicious and the service as excellent, with the aroma from the kitchen often enough to draw passers-by inside. Reviewers also highlight the warm atmosphere and knowledgeable staff who can guide first-time visitors through the menu.

The restaurant is at Shop 8 in the Red Sails Building in Hout Bay, and suits anyone looking for an authentic North Indian meal with a cosy, welcoming setting.

Tony's Roma in Flamingo Square is a bar and grill restaurant in the heart of Table View, offering a full bar with big screens for sports alongside an upmarket, family-friendly dining room. The restaurant serves breakfast, lunch and dinner, and describes itself as catering for the whole family, from young to old.

The menu runs from succulent ribs and crispy fresh salads to char-grilled steaks and flame-grilled burgers, with food prepared on a wood-fired oven to bring out bold and delicate flavours through seasoning during grilling. The combination of sports bar and restaurant gives it a dual role as both a casual spot to watch a game and a sit-down dinner venue.

The restaurant is at Flamingo Square on the corner of Study and Blaauwberg Road, and suits a family meal out or a casual evening watching sport over ribs and a drink.

Urban Health Pharmacy in Lansdowne is an independent pharmacy and member of the WeCare Pharmacy Network, open 24 hours a day. The pharmacy describes itself as dedicated to its customers' healthcare needs, offering a wide range of pharmacy services alongside everyday essentials.

Its round-the-clock hours make it a resource for prescriptions and urgent medication needs outside normal pharmacy hours, serving the Lansdowne area at any time of day or night, whether that is a late-night script or an early-morning top-up of everyday essentials.

Being part of a wider pharmacy network gives the branch access to shared buying power and systems, while still operating as an independent, locally run pharmacy that deals directly with its own customers.

The pharmacy is at 406 Imam Haron Road in Lansdowne, and suits anyone who needs a prescription filled, chronic medication managed, or everyday health items bought outside standard trading hours.

Urban Umami is an Asian-fusion restaurant serving small plates, mains and desserts that combine Asian flavours with South African ingredients. The restaurant's own information describes all-day dining alongside dedicated breakfast, lunch and dinner service, so customers can order a full meal or something lighter at almost any time.

The restaurant offers outside seating, Wi-Fi, secure parking and disabled access, catering to business diners working through a meal as well as families, couples and groups looking for a relaxed sit-down meal.

The restaurant is at 3 Energy Lane in the Bridgeways Precinct, Century City, and suits anyone looking for contemporary Asian-inspired dining with the flexibility of all-day service.

Virgin Active Okavango is a gym offering standard gym-floor training alongside express classes, Pilates and cycling sessions for members wanting a structured workout. Functional training is also available on-site, and the club's own listing confirms personal training can be booked at an additional cost for members wanting one-on-one coaching.

The mix of self-directed gym-floor access and scheduled classes gives members a choice between training alone on the equipment or joining a timed group session, depending on what suits their day.

The gym is at Shop 17 in Okavango Crossing, on the corner of Langeberg Road and Okavango Road in Kraaifontein, and suits members working on general fitness, strength, weight management, functional fitness or sport-specific training.

Anytime Fitness Sea Point is a 24-hour gym giving members round-the-clock access to cardio and strength training equipment on Main Road. The club's own information confirms scheduled classes alongside open gym-floor training, plus private showers and restrooms for members who want more than a basic access-only setup.

Membership also includes worldwide access to the Anytime Fitness network of gyms, letting members train at other branches while travelling rather than being limited to the Sea Point club alone.

The gym is at Marika Court, 142 Main Road in Sea Point, and suits members wanting flexible, round-the-clock training without being tied to set opening hours.

Artvark Gallery in Kalk Bay is a classic and contemporary art gallery founded in 1991 in Johannesburg, built originally around a handmade cutlery range. The gallery relocated to Kalk Bay in 1998, where it established both the gallery and a manufacturing studio in Retreat for its steel range.

The gallery curates a mix of original sculpture, ceramics, paintings, prints and handcrafted steel panels, alongside distinctive custom steelwork and bold, expressive design pieces. It describes itself as a landmark destination for contemporary South African art on the Cape coast, and offers international shipping for buyers further afield.

The gallery is at 48 Main Road in Kalk Bay, and suits art lovers and collectors looking for original South African sculpture, ceramics and steel design work in one setting.

The guesthouse is at 6 Verkouteren Crescent in Bloubergstrand, and suits travellers looking for a characterful, design-led stay on the coast rather than a standard hotel room.
